cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me submit the form tomorrow. I taught you to check applications, not be frightened of making a decision. Give me one trial extension.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've finally checked the old files. Now let one form arrive a day late and we'll find out whether anything actually breaks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write that beside my name, like I taught you. Next time I ask, we can start with the extension you already made work.

reason: Make the former pupil relationship determine which concession, record, interpretation or practical method A asks for, with each new B contribution changing the next request.
